# Stellar Physio Health & Wellness

> Leading physiotherapy clinic in Nairobi with over 12 years of experience. We offer expert care for back pain, sports injuries, joint pain, and rehabilitation across our Ngong Road, Karen, and Parklands branches.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://stellarphysio.com/): Overview of our clinic, conditions, and services.
- [About Us](https://stellarphysio.com/about): Our history, CEO message, and partnerships.
- [Contact](https://stellarphysio.com/contact): Branch locations, phone numbers, and contact form.
- [Book Appointment](https://stellarphysio.com/book-appointment): Online booking for all services.
- [Packages & Pricing](https://stellarphysio.com/packages): Wellness packages and special offers.
- [FAQs](https://stellarphysio.com/faqs): Answers about pricing, insurance, and visits.

- [Specialized Services](https://stellarphysio.com/services): Physiotherapy, Chiropractic, Cupping, Reflexology, and more.

## Conditions We Treat

- [Conditions](https://stellarphysio.com/conditions): Lower back pain, sports injuries, stroke rehab, and arthritis.
